text: 10th Survey WRONG OR RIGHT The majority of Republicans said the state was headed in the right direction (71%), favoring that response by a 51 point margin. Conversely, a strong majority of Democrats said the state is off on the wrong track (68%) and favored that response by a 46 point margin. Walk me through what they pointed to as the reason we’re going the right direction? (government, politics, economics, job opportunities, Trump) ECONOMIC OUTLOOK For eight of the last ten years, you’ve asked about the economic outlook. Reversing the trend, more Idahoans now expect economic conditions to get better over the next two years (44%), a 25 point increase over last year. What factored into that? DO WE CARE ABOUT IDLEG When it came to whether people valued the Legislature, what did they think was most important? (79% education, 70% jobs, 68%healthcare, 64%housing, 60%taxes 53% environment 41% transportation) IMMIGRATION When questioned about what level of government should be responsible for enforcing immigration in Idaho, 27% thought it should be federal, while30% said state. What factors into that? (6% said local, 27% said all, 1% said none, 6% said not sure) TAXES and PRIORITIES When it came to priorities for the Legislature when it comes to the budget, workforce and affordable house exceeded funding education. Walk me through that? (32% workforce and affordable housing, 28% K-12 ed, 23% tax relief, 9% transportation and infrastructure) How did this vary by region? (SW Idaho focused on housing, Republicans favored tax relief over Dems) ABORTION While 20% believe abortion should be completely prohibited, 26% support no restrictions on access. Other respondents favor restrictions at various stages, including only in the first six weeks of pregnancy (12%), through the first trimester (17%), and until fetal viability at 22-24 weeks (12%). On Restrictions: 9% say no exceptions 84% say exceptions for rape, incest and death of mom 64% say exceptions for rape, incest, death of mom but also health and non-viable pregnancy 27%no restrictions
